notes: X-COM: UFO Defense / Terror from the Deep original data, which OpenXcom runs: it asks for the GEODATA, GEOGRAPH, MAPS, ROUTES, SOUND, TERRAIN, UFOGRAPH, UFOINTRO and UNITS folders copied from the original (https://www.ufopaedia.org/index.php/Installing_(OpenXcom)). The original ships them upper-case and the exact-path conditions are case-sensitive, so a re-cased copy is not matched. No enginehost plugin yet.
